dataset_name: Dataset 3: Synthetic Research Benchmark Dataset of Healthcare Providers & Specialists
dataset_type: Provider & Specialist Dataset for Decision Support Algorithm Evaluation
description: A curated and synthetic research benchmark dataset containing 60 multi-specialty hospitals and 210 clinical specialists across 6 Indian medical travel hubs (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata). Designed specifically for evaluating transparent eligibility filtering and explainable multi-criteria ranking algorithms.

provenance_policy.ethical_notice: Ratings, doctor experience, fees, and operational cost tiers are synthetic simulation attributes generated for algorithm evaluation and decision support prototyping. They must not be interpreted as real-world official performance evaluations.
